title: Pin tumbler cylinder
object: Five-pin euro-profile half cylinder (DIN 18252, 30/10) and its key in longitudinal section
idea: Authentication by matching a secret: every factor must match (AND)
summary: Each key pin is cut for one depth of the key, so the right key lifts every crown exactly to the shear line between plug and body. The key is cut in 0.5 mm steps; a key one cut wrong leaves pin 3 a millimetre low, its driver straddles the line and the plug will not turn. Only when all five gaps sit on the line does the plug, and its cam, turn.
usedFor: Security-concept explainers: shared secrets, multi-factor checks as a logical AND
Locksmith and security-hardware training: bitting codes, depth steps, shear line
